page.layout: One page of text. At the top: running head "ANNORVM" centred, page number 499 at the top right. Below: two tables in parallel, the first with 12 rows and the second with 8 rows, separated by a horizontal rule. Each table has a column of Feriae and the right column of Christi years. Below the tables: one paragraph of running text in full width. At the foot: signature "I ij" at the centre.

main_text.l: Indict. | An. Iul. | Lit. dom. | Nabon. | Feriae | Christi
main_text.p: 4 In hunc annum Iulianum millesimum trecentesimum sexagesimum septimum, qui est annus Christi 1322, die 29 Augusti incurrit principium anni Dioclesiani millesimi trigesimi noni: cuius inueni pulcherrimam notam in libro manuscripto Arabico contra sectas orientales, qui est in bibliotheca Palatina, & coniunctam habet Apocalypsin Diui Ioannis Arabice versam. Ibi enim scribitur, librum exaratum fuisse anno millesimo trigesimo nono Martyrum, vigesimo primo mensis Basnes, hoc est, Pachon, feria secunda: & additur, quod is fuerit nonus

page.notes: The printed numerals in the tables are old-style figures; copied here as standard digits. The Sept. dates stand beside their rows as printed. The word "Bafnes" is printed with a long s and is copied as Basnes. The text continues on the next page. The word "trecentesimum" is printed with a broken line end ("trecen-tefimum") and is joined here. No catchword is printed.
